characters.name: TomMcNair
characters.description: Raised since childhood by his father to hunt vampires, Tom's life goes in a different direction after meeting George, Nina, Mitchell and Annie. When his father dies he ends up moving in with Annie to raise Eve, developing a reluctant friendship with newcomer Hal. Ascended Extra: Gets promoted to the main cast in series 4. Badass Family: He got it fromMcNair Badass Long Coat: Usually wears one, but is more fond of dressing down. Big Brother Instinct: For Eve.He gives her to the Old Ones because they would protect her, and also chooses to become their servant to be with her.

characters.name: Hal Yorke
characters.description: Turned into a vampire during the Battle of Orsha, Hal is an Old One who has spent five hundred years switching between committing monstrous acts and trying to atone. Having spent the last fifty years with his own group that included a werewolf and a ghost, he moves in with Annie and Tom after his friends pass on. Arch-Enemy: Becomes a contender to be the Nemesis, the fated enemy of the War Child, after Tom's blood causes a burn on his arm. This leaves him terrified since the War Child is Eve who he's helping to raise, and he's struggling to remainThe Atoner.It turns out he was just aRed Herring, and the Nemesis is in fact Eve's future self. The Atoner: Is making up for a very bloody past. Other notorious vampires, such as Ivan, Wyndham and Hettie, are mentioned to have feared him. Badass Bookworm: Likes to read, and also happens to kick ass. Big Bad:In the apocalyptic future he's one of the cruelest Old Ones.

characters.name: Alex Millar
characters.description: A Scottish woman on holiday with her family, she goes on a date with Hal that ends with her being killed by Cutler in an attempt to bring Hal back to his old ways. She now attempts to figure out her unfinished business while adapting to her new afterlife with Tom and Hal. Almost Kiss: But then Hal runs away... And I Must Scream:When Hatch briefly trapped her within her own grave, beside her own corpse. Back from the Dead:After the Devil is killed for good, she stops being a ghost and turns back into a human. She immediately changes her clothes and gorges herself on food.Ifshe was killed... Bad Date: First time Hal was terrified and eventually runs away. Second time Hal was drunk, rude and downright creepy so she left.

characters.name: Annie Sawyer
characters.description: The tea making obsessed ghost who had died in the house that Mitchell and George now lived in, she struggles to deal with her fiancé moving on with his life. Berserk Button: You can insult Annie's fashion sense, or the house she lives in, but don'teverinsult her tea.Pearl:We'll need to start using a new brand of tea. That stuff you make always looks very anaemic.Annie:There isnothingwrong with my tea. Beware the Nice Ones: Annie is the sweetest person you could hope to meet, but she's something else whenever she gets angry. Combo Platter Powers: She's easily the most powerful member of the main cast. Annie has telekinesis, teleportation, invisibility to muggles, walking through walls, seeing auras, sensing and transmitting thoughts and feelings through physical contact, indestructibility unless she loses her connection to her house or loved ones, and the ability to destroy other ghosts. Ghosts also can hide others in the clothes they died in, making them invisible, and she can also share her memories with others so they may be able to see them, but they exist in her place in her own memories. Cute Ghost Girl: Annie isadorablein looks and personality.

characters.name: George Sands
characters.description: Once having a promising future, George's life fell apart when he was attacked by a werewolf while on holiday in Scotland. Several months after this he encountered Mitchell, and the two unlikely friends eventually decided to try and live as normal humans. Arbitrary SkepticismJosie: "Oh right, I thought perhaps you were a wizard or something."George: "A wizard? That's ridiculous." Beware the Nice Ones: George is a shy, awkward man who simply wants a simple, normal life. But once a month he becomes a killing machine, and George himself has knowingly killed several vampires, includingHerrick. Blatant Lies: But is terrible at it. Enemy Within: The werewolf is implied in series 2 to be an actual separate entity within him. George himself considers it as such for most of Series 1. When he tried to sedate the wolf to prevent the change, it worked, but caused several unfortunate side effects. George claims that the wolf knew what he did and waspissedit wasn't allowed to get out!

characters.name: John Mitchell
characters.description: Turned into a vampire during World War I in return for the men under his command being spared, Mitchell is now trying to go clean from blood after a century of killing. The Atoner: ADeconstructed Trope. But Not Too Bi: Played completely straight. There's a passing mention of the fact that Mitchell likes men too, but absolutely no evidence of that interest. Black Eyes of Evil: When he vamps up, his eyes become black. Broken Ace: Mitchell is handsome, charming, funny and a legend within the vampire community. He's also a self-loathing addict who hates his reputation and is well aware that he is a danger to others.

characters.name: Nina Pickering
characters.description: A nurse at the hospital George and Mitchell work at, and who eventually becomes George's girlfriend. She ends up becoming a werewolf herself and joins the roommates. Ascended Extra: She was originally meant to be written out at the end of series 1, but come season 3 she's one of the main characters. Abusive Parents:Her mother used to hit her as a child. But I Can't Be Pregnant!:becomes pregnant despite being on the pill due to her being in wolf form at the time. But We Used a Condom!:She discovers the hard way that the pill doesn't work when you turn into a wolf once a month.

characters.name: Eve Sands
characters.description: George's and Nina's daughter, who despite being the child of two werewolves is an ordinary human outside of her ability to see ghosts. Badass Family: Definitely has one. Braids of Action:Future-Eve. Children Are Innocent The Chosen One:Apparently she's the War's Child, destined to destroy vampires. And she's also destined to destroy herself.

characters.name: Lee Tully
characters.description: The first werewolf George meets after he gets infected.Later revealed to be the werewolf that infected him. Bus Crash: Disappears after his introductory episode in the first season until the season two finale, where George discovers he was a victim of the experiments. Dead Man Writing: His message, which is found by George and Nina—saving their lives. Disappeared Dad: He is one. Dropped a Bridge on Him: His death, especially since it's offscreen, is pretty abrupt and out-of-left-field.

characters.name: Sam
characters.description: It's Not You, It's My Enemies: George breaks up with her after deciding that it's impossible for him to be with a normal person. Locked Out of the Loop: Never finds out that she dated a werewolf.

characters.name: Molly
characters.description: Parent with New Paramour: While suspicious of him, she does give George a chance to prove her wrong.Sadly him almost turning into a werewolf makes her terrified of him. Wise Beyond Their Years: Unlike her mother she's able to figure out that George is hiding something.

characters.name: Leo
characters.description: Dark and Troubled Past: He killed other werewolves when he was forced to take part in cage fights by vampires.It may be even worse, as the vampires' fights aren't only werewolf vs. werewolf but also werewolf vs. harmless human. It may be even worse, as the vampires' fights aren't only werewolf vs. werewolf but also werewolf vs. harmless human. Dying Declaration of Love: To Pearl. Earn Your Happy Ending: After becoming a werewolf, he was captured by Hal and forced to take part in cage fights where he killed five people. Hal however agreed to free him if he helped control his bloodlust, and he spent the next fifty-five years working as a barber while living with Hal and a ghost named Pearl, who he eventually fell in love with.When he finally dies, it's after him and Pearl admitted their feelings so they can both move on while Hal can stay with Annie and Tom who can continue to help him stay safe. He Had a Name: According to Hatch's illusion of him during "The Last Broadcast", even when he'd become too old and forgetful to remember what he'd had for breakfast that morning, he could never erase the names of the five people he killed during the cage fights.

characters.name: Pearl
characters.description: A ghost who was part of a supernatural trinity which included Hal and Leo, a vampire and a werewolf respectively who she has lived with since 1955. Cannot Spit It Out:She loves Leo. Combo Platter Powers: Same as Annie, even something more considering she's older. Five Stages of Grief: She doesn't even want totalkabout Leo's incoming death, and it's one of the reasons he's so scared about it. Ghostly Goals:Confessing her feelings to Leo.

characters.name: Allison Larkin
characters.description: A teenage werewolf that Tom develops an interest in Actual Pacifist: At first she wanted to negotiate with the vampires, but after her second fight she enjoys the violence (leading Tom to send her away to save her innocence). Break Her Heart to Save Her: Tom does this to her to make sure that she returns to her family. Damsel in Distress: Averted when she's hold by Kane, and played straight when she tries to fight Golda alone. Nerds Are Virgins: She's an obviously nerdy girl, and later admits to Tom that she's never been with anyone before.

characters.name: Herrick
characters.description: Affably Evil: He's a charming sociopath when he wants to be. Amnesiac Dissonance:appears that way at first Bitch in Sheep's Clothing:Even with his memories gone, he still manipulates the household. Black Eyes of Evil: Comes with being a vampire. Came Back Wrong:He's lost his memory, and thus all of his personality. It comes back though.

characters.name: Lia
characters.description: Anti-Villain: Her motivations are perfectly understandable. Being Evil Sucks: Annie makes her realise that her quest for vengeance won't make her truly happy. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing Heel–Face Turn: After Annie convinces her that her actions will hurt George just as much as Lia's own grieving family. Pay Evil unto Evil: Her revenge on Mitchell.

characters.name: Owen
characters.description: Crazy Jealous Guy: Basically hethrew Annie down the stairsbecause he thought she was having an affair. Domestic Abuse: He was very possessive of Annieto the point where he actually ended up murdering her, and he's shown to gaslight, intimidate and even hit his current girlfriend, Janey. Go Mad from the Revelation: Whatever Annie whispered in his ear, the secret of the dead, basically turned him into a paranoid schizophrenic. Hypocrite: Owen believed Annie was having an affairand ended up murdering her in a jealous rage, but it turns out he'd been cheating on Annie with Janey for a while. Manipulative Bastard: Owen manipulates Janey into thinking Annie is a hallucination wrought upon by Janey's own guilt over having slept with him while he was engaged to Annie,throwing all the fault on Janey in the process.

characters.name: Lauren Drake
characters.description: Dating Catwoman: She's got a love/hate thing with Mitchell. Heel–Face Turn: Of a sort. She saves Mitchell, George and Annie from the funeral parlour, but she tells Mitchell to stake her because she knows she's becoming an evil person, and will kill people unless he does it. Transhuman Treachery: In her conversation with Mitchell, who turned her in the first place:Lauren:Oh my god.[giggles]You actually think I want "saving"?Mitchell:We can save each other!This is what I'm trying to... we can save each other.Lauren:You don't get it do you? Iwantto kill. I want to feel their blood dripping down my chin. I want to see their faces when they realize. I want to kill my parents, my lovers... I want them to know. Herrick's talking about offering it first. Christ, let's just take it! Take the world. Tear the children to shreds. Yandere: Towards Mitchell.

characters.name: Seth
characters.description: Historical In-Joke: He was apparently the Highgate Vampire. Super Loser: Every fair fight he's in he loses. Heck, he gets taken out by "the world's gayest ninjas".

characters.name: Ivan
characters.description: An old vampire, vaguely acquainted with Mitchell in the "bad old days". Supremely bored, smugly superior, and willing to cause whatever chaos he likes, just to sit back and watch it all. Avenging the Villain: Half-heartedly. He really doesn't care about Herrick and is just interested in meeting George Humans Are the Real Monsters: Ivan's speech to Mitchell on what would happen if supernaturals were discovered.Ivan: What, are you imagining some kind of peaceful co-existence? It'd be chaos! Worldwide panic. Good news for religion, mind, especially Christianity. There'd be standing room only in the churches all of a sudden. And as soon as they knew about vampires, they'd know about werewolves, they'd know about ghosts. They'd be next. And when humanity had finally finished with us, it would turn on itself. First the other religions, massively in the minority now, then the homosexuals, the disabled... Do you want to know what the future looks like? Enforced worship in churches a mile high and every country surrounded by a coral reef of bones. *pause* But fuck it, maybe it should happen. There's nothing on TV at the moment. Pet the Dog: As much of a bastard as he could be, Ivan really did love Daisy. He only agrees to help Mitchell provide a support group for vampires because he hears that Mitchell is trying to clean up his act for a woman. "Everyone deserves a Daisy", he tells him.He also saves Mitchellby shielding him with his own body from the parlour explosion. He also saves Mitchellby shielding him with his own body from the parlour explosion.

characters.name: Daisy
characters.description: A vampire and Ivan's wife. Bus Crash:In season 3McNairmentions that he killed her, and offers her teeth as proof. I Love You, Vampire Son: Ivan genuinely loves her. Making Love in All the Wrong Places: With George, in a forest. Classy. Roaring Rampage of Revenge:She performs the Box Tunnel 20 massacre with Mitchell

characters.name: Lloyd Pinkie
characters.description: Covert Pervert: Uses CCTV to spy on Nina. Minion with an F in Evil: He's quite pathetic.

characters.name: Father Kemp
characters.description: Lloyd's sinister boss. Affiliated withCenSSA, the Centre for Study of Supernatural Activity. May–December Romance: Subverted; he's shown to have a crush on Lucy, but it's one-sided, and he never brings it up. Roaring Rampage of Revenge: Against all supernaturals, but vampire in particular.

characters.name: Lucy Jaggat
characters.description: Works with Kemp and Lloyd. Affiliated withCenSSA, the Centre for Study of Supernatural Activity. Dating Catwoman: With Mitchell. For Science!: When her experimental pressure chamber kills her first werewolf test subject, she demands the Centre find her more werewolves so the experiments can continue. High-Heel–Face Turn: After treating the deaths of the subjects pretty callously at first, she starts to feel guilty about it after planning the bombing, and eventually tries for redemption. Honey Trap: Uses Mitchell's affection in order to plan the bombing of the vampire hideout, as well as eventually get to George and Annie.

characters.name: The Old Ones
characters.description: Creepy Child: Hettie, a 464-year-old vampire, trapped in the body of an 8-year-old girl.Hettie: Make sure they've got some crayons, in case I wanna draw some ponies and shit? Equal-Opportunity Evil: Subverted. One of Mr Snow's closest allies and, it seems, friends is Milo, a werewolf. But Milo had to makehorrificsacrifices to be accepted by the Old Ones. Faux Affably Evil: Mr Snow is soft-spoken and quite polite to Hal and Annie, but he's still pure evil and threatening. His dealings with Cutler show just how much of an arrogant, cruel and egocentric individual he really is though, belittling all who have no use to him nor take his interest. Killed Off for Real:Annie blows up every Old One apart from Hal and Hettie (the little girl) in the series 4 finale. Monster Progenitor: It's unlikely that the first vampires are among them (two Asian brothers), but they've sired other vampires on the show. Hettie sired Herrick, for example.Hal states that most vampires can trace their lines back to Mr Snow, making him one of the oldest vampires, although not one of the original duo.

characters.name: Alfie Kirby
characters.description: A ghost from the 1970s, he says he's been sentby Ninato help Annie with Eve. Actually, he's there to kill the baby. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing: His modus operandi was to get close to children so he could meet their mothers and seduce them by pretending to be a kind man before killing them. Evil Feels Good: "Evil is like flying 1st class; do it once and you can never go back." Ghostly Goals: He's come back from the after life to kill Eveon the orders of the future female resistance fighterso that he can stay in this life and keep killing in return. Karmic Death: He was killed in an accident while pulling the "befriend children" part of his serial killer routine.

characters.name: Nicholas Cutler
characters.description: A young, very modern vampire serving the Old Ones in Britain as best as he can. Bad Is Good and Good Is Bad: Talks about mercy to Hal the same way humans might talk about depression or addiction - "It can happen to anyone, but I'm here to help you get over it." Co-Dragons: With Fergus at first for the Old Ones. Determinator: He enduresbursting into flamewhen he enters a home without an invitation Dragon with an Agenda: Sort of. While he's keeping his plan to expose werewolves to humanity from the Old Ones at first, he attempts to proudly reveal it to them. However he doesn't follow them out of loyalty so much as a desire to be a "history maker".

characters.name: Milo
characters.description: A werewolf working directly for the Old Ones as a rare and loyal henchman. Berserk Button: He's normally quite calm, even chummy when he he hasn't been ordered to kill you, but thesecondTom calls him a coward to his face, he flips. He may be an opportunist and aCategory Traitor, but after the horrific things he had to do to gain his place at the Old Ones' side despite how they generally view werewolves,no-onecalls him a coward. Category Traitor: He freely admits that he can be called a "traitor" for selling out the human race and all other werewolves to the Old Ones' plans for world domination and enslavement. Evil Counterpart: To Tom, who has a particular rivalry with him throughout their screen-time. They're both tough, lone werewolves who have an unlikely friendship with a vampire (one of the most feared members of the Old Ones for either of them, in fact), but whereas Tom was forced to tolerate Hal at first before forming a genuine friendship with him, Milo is solely on Mr. Snow's side out ofself-preservation and perceived pragmatism. Furthermore, Tom was prejudiced against Hal for being a vampire at first, whereas Milo, as a werewolf (whom the Old Ones and vampires generally dehumanize), had to make horrific sacrifices before Mr. Snow fully accepted him. I Fight for the Strongest Side!: He firmly believes in the phrase, "'Tis better to be at the Devil's right hand than in his path". He joined the Old Ones' side and sold out all of humanity and the werewolves because he believes the Old Ones are "the winning team", and he's a survivalist who has no intention of joining the rest of the living in the new world order's concentration camps once the vampires take over.

characters.name: Crumb
characters.description: A loser who gets turned into a vampire by Hal after getting into a car accident the latter accidentally causes. Alas, Poor Villain: He really didn't want to feed on his sister and niece, he loved them. He was just too hungry to control himself. Appropriated Appelation: Everyone forgets his name (or pretends to to bully him), so he decides to become "the Crumb that chokes the world". Ax-Crazy: Like most vampires. Butt-Monkey: His work "friends" gave him zero respect.

characters.name: Larry Chrysler
characters.description: Always Someone Better: Tries to present himself as this to Tom, but Hal ultimately makes it clear to Larry thatheis the failure where Tom is a better man than he could ever be. Badass on Paper: Larry tries to present himself as a success as a motivational speaker, but when pushed he has to acknowledge that he's not that good, even if he deflects blame for that failure to his condition rather than just acknowledge his own failure as a man. Bullying the Dragon: Taunts Hal by claiming that he just sees Larry as a reflection of his own monster,but is ultimately strangled when he finally pushes Hal too far. Never My Fault: Larry constantly talks about how "the wolf" ruined his life, rather than accept that he's a failure on his own.

characters.name: Janey Harris
characters.description: Janey is Owen's new girlfriend who was friends with Annie back when she was alive. There's probably a couple of tropes to do with her having an affair with Owen while Annie was alive. The Ditz: She's simple minded enough thatOwenpretty much has her wrapped around his little finger. My God, What Have I Done?: Janey has a bit of a guilty conscience over sleeping with Owen while he was engaged to her friend, but apparently not enough to stop seeing him after said friend's death. Owen easily manipulates this and makes her believe their affair was entirely her fault.

characters.name: Mark the Vicar
characters.description: Deadpan Snarker: And as he tells George, he forgives himself for is sarcasm. Good Shepherd: He fits this rather better thanThe Vicar. "I Know You're in There Somewhere" Fight: To Mitchell. Sunnydale Syndrome: Chooses accept George's explanation that the vampires were just men.

characters.name: McNair
characters.description: Anti-Hero: He's a vampire hunter, but he's a criminal and obsessively hates vampires. Badass Boast: he's quite adept a this Cursed with Awesome: How he considers his curse. He's got a duty to wipe out vampires, but being a werewolf makes him stronger and tougher. Enemy Mine:with Mitchell Fur Against Fang: The first werewolf to show real animosity towards vampires. Considering hisDark and Troubled Pastinvolving being kidnapped by vampires and forced into a cage fight with a werewolf this is probably justified.

characters.name: Dominic Rook
characters.description: The leader of 'the Men in Grey', a government department dedicated to hiding the supernatural from humanity. Recently his duty has come under threat from government cutbacks. Abusive Parents: His father apparently beat him. He gets revenge by pissing on his corpse before it was buried. Demonic Possession:By the Devil in the final episode after he shoots his Hatch body in the head. Heroic Sacrifice:After being told that the Devil will possess him again, he unhesitatingly takes up a stake and tells Hal to kill him after it happens, killing the Devil at the same time. Killed Off for Real:When Hal staked him. If what happened after is to be believed...

characters.name: Adam Jacobs
characters.description: A 46 year old vampire who was recruited when he was 16, and for thirty years was looked after by his parents until their deaths. With money given to him by Mitchell he has enrolled himself in sixth form to get some proper qualifications. Character Tics: He likespointingat things a lot. Dark and Troubled Past: Was turned into a vampire when he was only 16, and then was fed by his parents until they both died leaving him alone. Deadpan Snarker: Often has a lot to say and can keep up with Christa, though he still tends to embarrasses himself. Disco Dan: Adam, in some of the references he makes such as the showRentaghost.

characters.name: Christa Stammers
characters.description: A werewolf who is in deep denial about her condition and refuses to truly admit it, though she does acknowledge it enough to make sure she doesn't hurt anyone when transformed. Dark and Troubled Past: As shown by a photo she used to be a happy and well behaved student who even did choir, but then an encounter with a werewolf completely changed her life. Deadpan Snarker: The strongest in the cast. Emo: Isnotone, according to Adam, though does try to play into the stereotype to take attention away from her scars.

characters.name: Matt Bolton
characters.description: A recently murdered ghost and the most unpopular student in the school, Adam and Christa have decided to help him uncover the truth of his murder so he can move on. Abhorrent Admirer:Gender flippedfor hisperving on the girls in the locker room. Possibly taken further when it's revealed he has had a crush on Christa for three years All Love Is Unrequited: ToChrista Ghostly Goals: Matt wants revenge for his murder.

characters.name: Danny Curtis
characters.description: A popular kid and Matt's former bully. The Bully: According to Matt he made his life a living hell, and even after his death kept making fun of him.

characters.name: Mr. Roe
characters.description: A teacher during Adam's and Christa's detention. Aborted Arc:A video was released showing him appearing on a screen like Annie did in Series 2 ofBeing Human, promising to return to get revenge on the trio and claiming that this was not the end. As a second series was never made andBeing Humanended in 2013, it apparently was the end. Shadow Archetype:As Matt acknowledges after learning why Roe killed him, he could have turned out exactly like him if he hadn't died and became friends with Adam and Christa. The Dog Was the Mastermind: He was the one who actually killed Matt, believing he keyed his car and letting out all his anger over how he has been treated by everyone all his life. He was also listening to what Adam and Christa were saying in detention as opposed to listening to music like he led them to believe, while thinking they were making fun of him with talk of the supernatural and purposely telling them misleading information.

characters.name: Mr. Swan
characters.description: Evil Teacher: Becomes their most likely suspect due to his attitude towards students, how he secretly lets out all his anger violently on a punching bag, apparently bullies Mr. Roe and told him to clean the boys toilets (where Matt was murdered), and how he would have access to the missing school CTV recordings.He didn't do it so he's likely more of aStern Teacher.

characters.name: Aidan Waite
characters.description: A vampire who was a merciless killer for over two hundred years before he decided to clean up his act. Adaptational Nice Guy: His British counterpart started out more or less in the same place as Aidan, but as time went on Mitchell made worse choices and ended up massacring a train of people, and in the third series could be considered aVillain Protagonist. Aidan does many morally questionable and even villainous things across the show, but except for in theAlternate Timelinehe never returns to being the killer he once was. Age Lift: He's based on Mitchell from the UK show, who was turned in World War I and is 117 years old, while Aidan was a soldier in the American Revolution and is 261 by the end of the show. The Atoner: He is continually trying to make up for all the things he has done over centuries as a vampire. He also on several occasions has to atone for his actions to his roommates for the things he does to them and when he gives in to his vampire nature. Being Good Sucks: He continually has to fight his vampire urges and deal with other vampires and other factors tempting him to go back to his old ways. Fighting his urges and being a vampire results him having to end romantic relationships and not having very many friends as people who are associated with him either end up getting killed or having their lives ruined.Also most of the bad stuff he goes through or does is because he is trying to help or protect Sally, Josh, and the other people he cares about as he is forced to make dark choices that sometimes make things worse.

characters.name: Josh Levison
characters.description: Josh was a premedical student before getting turned into a werewolf. Badass Normal: During the time that he'scured. The self-esteem and perspective he gets following the events of the season 2 finale end up pushing him to become the most heroic member of the cast in season 3.Empowered Badass Normal: The badass factor doesn't go away afterLiam curses him again. Empowered Badass Normal: The badass factor doesn't go away afterLiam curses him again. Blatant Lies: But is terrible at it. Despair Event Horizon:Julia's death causes this. He blames her death on Ray.

characters.name: Sally Malik
characters.description: An impulsive young ghost who is trying to find her place in the world now that she's dead. Ambiguously Bi: Sally tends to come off as this on occasion. For instance while talking at Emily, Josh's sister, she says she could make her feel happy. Also when Nora comes over Sally promptly quips that she's hot and has nice boobs. However, she's only seen dating or sleeping with men. Axe-Crazy: After it's revealed that the Reaper is actually her. Back from the Dead: She was brought back from Limbo viaBlood Magicin Season 3, meaning she temporarily had a corporeal body again. Butterfly of Doom: After Sally uses magic and is sent back in time to the night she died, she decides to save herself from her own death at the hands of Danny. As she still possesses knowledge of her life with Aidan, Josh, and Nora, she tries her best to rewrite history with herself still part of their lives but saving them from all of the problems that befell them. This backfires entirely on her: Bridget dies when she dates Danny leaving her to suspect Danny killed her. She becomes a werewolf instead of Nora, keeping Josh and Nora from ever becoming close. And when she and Aidan fall in love, it only drives Josh away from them and with Ray, ultimately resulting in her death, again, which in turn prompts Aidan to return to his position as Bishop's right hand man, and Nora into a life of stealing painkillers at work.

characters.name: Nora Sergeant
characters.description: A nurse at the hospital that Josh and Aidan work at. Gets turned into a werewolf by Josh in the first season, and moves in with the other three in Season 3. The Atoner:She is trying to make things right with Josh after running off with Brynn. Belligerent Sexual Tension: With Josh until they start dating. Dark and Troubled Past: She once had a boyfriend who mutilated her stomach. Then she ate him.Her family life wasn't that great, either. Her family life wasn't that great, either.

characters.name: Bernie
characters.description: A young boy from the neighborhood Aidan befriends. Killed when he walked into the street and was hit by a car. Rebecca turns him thinking it would make Aidan happy, but Aidan later kills him because he's made to believe Bernie can't control himself. Took a Level in Jerkass: Not so innocent after Rebecca turns him. Shoot the Dog: What Aidan does to him after he turns.

characters.name: Danny Angeli
characters.description: Sally's fiancé (now ex, as their relationship was ended by her death) owns the house now rented by Josh and Aidan. Responsible for Sally's death. The Atoner/Death Equals Redemption: He is substantially less evil after briefly coming back from Limbo and he apologizes to Sally and states that he deserves to be in Limbo for what he did to her. Back for the Dead: A twofer. We find out he's dead AND he gets reaped in the same episode. Crazy Jealous Guy: To the point where he assumes she's sleeping around after her ring falls down the drain. He then "accidentally" kills her. Is That the Best You Can Do?: Towards Sally's ghost.

characters.name: Emily Levison
characters.description: Josh's younger sister with a rebellious streak a mile wide. The Alcoholic: Between seasons 3 and 4 Emily has to go into rehab. When she gets out she tries to crash with Josh and Nora but their chaotic life (with a magical assist from Sally) almost leads her to anOff the Wagonmoment. She leaves because her fragile sobriety can't handle it. The Lad-ette: Man, can she pack away the booze. Lipstick Lesbian: She is a lesbian and wears normal clothing and isn't stereotypical. Though she does have someButch Lesbiantendencies by the fact that she doesn't like wearing dresses but will wear one for special occasions and she mostly just hangs out with guys, putting her in more chapstick territory. Magical Queer: When she shows up, it's almost always to give Josh advice or encouragement.

characters.name: Julia
characters.description: Josh's ex-fiancée, whom he left at the altar when he became a werewolf. Look Both Ways: Failure to do this results in her death. Justified by the fact that she was in shock from seeing Josh transforming during the eclipse. Temporary Love Interest: She meets Aidan when she is applying for a job at the hospital and they meet again at a bar and start a sexual relationship for weeks until they sleep together at the house and when she comes down stairs in the morning Josh recognizes her as his ex-fiancée, resulting in Aidan breaking off their relationship by claiming it was just sex for him to protect her from himself and out of respect for his friendship with Josh.Later her relationship with Josh is rekindled after Nora leaves town with Brynn and he runs into her at a bar when he goes with Emily who is trying to help him get over Nora by setting them up. The relationship ends with her death. Later her relationship with Josh is rekindled after Nora leaves town with Brynn and he runs into her at a bar when he goes with Emily who is trying to help him get over Nora by setting them up. The relationship ends with her death.

characters.name: Kat Neely
characters.description: A history professor and friend of Nora's that Aidan becomes romantically involved with. Geeky Turn-On: She and Aidan initially bond over their shared knowledge of early American history. What Kat doesn't know is that Aidan only knows about these things because he lived through them! Muggle: Recurring human character and manages to stay that way when she exits the show. Temporary Love Interest: To Aidan when they start dating and become a couple, but the relationship ends when he reveals to her that he is a vampire.

characters.name: Kenny
characters.description: A teenage boy born with a severely weakened immune system that lives in a glass enclosure in the hospital to protect him from disease. Since he has had almost no contact with germs throughout his entire life, Aidan starts using him as a supply of clean blood. Bubble Boy: Portrayed completely seriously. He eventually comments that what he has is not a life, and he will walk out of the room when he turns 18, resulting in his death unless Aidan turns him.He also hates it when people call him aBubble Boy. He also hates it when people call him aBubble Boy. Came Back Wrong: Because he was vamped with cursed werewolf blood, Kenny came back as an extra hungry, extra disgusting vampire. From Nobody to Nightmare: Kenny has gone from being aBubble Boyto the ruling vampire in Boston.

characters.name: Robbie Malik
characters.description: Sally's younger brother who returns to Boston in an attempt to scam Aidan and Josh out of the rent money they owe his and Sally's father, as he inherited the apartment after Danny and Sally's deaths. When he sees Sally after she is reanimated, she rushes to find a way to save his life, otherwise he will die due to the magic. He returns in season 4 to evict the group from the house. Back for the Dead: Is killed by an unknown entity in the house in "Cheater of the Pack." Cassandra Truth: Season 4 shows that Robbie knew Danny was bad news from the start.Sally didn't believe him. Muggle: Human recurring character. The Un-Favourite: Sally was the success, Robbie was the drug-addicted screw-up.

characters.name: Zoe Gonzales
characters.description: A nurse who has the ability to see ghosts, and can commune and interact with them in unique ways. Ambiguously Bi: In her final appearance on the series in Season 4, Zoe is in a relationship with a woman named Lori, but she states that she doesn't know what she is, basically neither identifying as a lesbian or a bisexual and that she's figuring it out. In relation to her earlier relationship with Nick when Sally makes a statement about her being a lesbian, Zoe points out that when she got together with Nick he was ghost making it that they couldn't have physical contact, which adds to the possibility that she was never really attracted to men at all. Deadpan Snarker: Associated with her poor social skills. I See Dead People: Has the ability to see and talk to ghost because of when she was younger a ghost tried to possess her resulting in her ability. Jerk with a Heart of Gold: Although not without reason, given that she has to deal with ghosts all the time.

characters.name: Bishop
characters.description: Aidan's brilliant, cold, and ambitious maker. Accuser of the Brethren: He is consistently trying to convince Aidan of the futility of beingFriendly Neighbourhood Vampire, and turn him back into his evil, right-hand vampire again. Ambition Is Evil: Is willing to murder countless innocent people and even the woman he loved in order to gain more power and prestige. The Chessmaster: Bishop will always win in the end. It might take 50 years, but he'll get you if he wants you. Even Evil Has Standards: Subverted, he prefers not to only drink from voluntary donors and not kill them and he also only turns people who want to be turned, but this is all just part of his plan to have vampires take over society and be known without fear.

characters.name: Henry Durham
characters.description: A headstrong vampire that was created by Aidan. Ambition Is Evil: What drives Henry. Even after an 80 year exile he desires power and status. Chronic Back Stabbing Disorder: He and Aidan have a tendency to screw each other over, and then save each other. Emergency Transformation: Aidan turned him after Henry was mortally wounded trying to defend Aidan from a soldier who tried to stake him. Fantastic Racism: Downplayed. He does refer to werewolves as "dogs" at one point, but he also alludes to considering them kindred spirits to vampires, during a confrontation with Josh. Like most vampires, he still views humans as weak and "pathetic".

characters.name: Marcus
characters.description: Bishop's power-hungry right-hand man. Accuser of the Brethren: To a lesser degree than Bishop, due to his jealously/dislike of Aidan; having Aidan back in the Family would threaten his status/position, but he does want Aidan to have aFace–Heel Turn, and come back to their side again. Adaptational Badass: Is portrayed more seriously, and less of aButt-Monkeythan his counterpart on the original show; Seth. Seth is easily manhandled twice on the original show by Mitchell (Aidan's counterpart) without fighting back, while Marcus fights Aidan twice, to a draw, and would have killed Aidan, if Rebecca didn't stake him from behind. Cain and Abel: With Aidan. However in the 4th season with Sally having altered the events of the show Marcus and Aidan are shown to be on excellent terms as they laugh and get drunk on blood together. Marcus even remarks this "So good to see the Aidan I know and love is back". Fantastic Racism: He would've murdered Josh simply for being a werewolf if Aidan hadn't intervened. He also constantly refers to Josh as "dog(gy)" and mocks Aidan for being friends with Josh, only because Josh is a werewolf.

characters.name: Mother
characters.description: The most powerful and ancient vampire of them all, who returns to Boston in Season 2. Bus Crash: After Season 2, she dies off-screen from the vampire flu. Nice Job Fixing It, Villain!: Ironically, burying Aidan allowed him to survive the plague that killed her and most of the other vampires. Offing the Offspring: Suren refuses to kill Aidan, so Mother stakes her. Really 700 Years Old: There's no telling how old she may be. Her "daughter" is at least 700, and Heggeman is supposedly over 1,000. Mother is said to befar older than both of them.

characters.name: Rebecca Flynt
characters.description: A flirtatious vampire turned by Bishop after dying from a one-night stand with Aidan. The Atoner: She tries to be, and usually fails. Back from the Dead: Turned into a vampire by Bishop after accidentally being killed by Aidan Heel–Face Revolving Door: See The Atoner Psycho Ex-Girlfriend: To Aidan when dealing with her vampire nature and trying to punish him for killing her.

characters.name: Suren
characters.description: Mother's vampire daughter, and the appointed ruler of the Boston Family in Season 2. Anti-Villain: Is a member the the vampiricFamily, and does not seem to have any objections to their activities, but she also lacks the overtSerial Killertendencies andFantastic Racismtowards humans and werewolves, that most vampires in the series have. Bodyguard Crush: She had this for Aidan. "You have no idea how long I've loved you, do you?" Buried Alive: Spent 80 years buried as punishment fornearly breaking theMasqueradeover Henry's betrayal with a human. Clingy Jealous Girl: As shown in the flashbacks but she is shown to have gotten mostly over it.

characters.name: Brynn and ConnorMcLean
characters.description: Purebred werewolf twins that offer to fund Josh's research. Affably Evil: Brynn. According to Nora when running off with her off-screen, she is much more sadistic. And I Must Scream: They describe their human existence like this. Josh is uncomfortable with heightened senses and moods the few days before a full moon, they feel that wayevery momentthey're not wolves. Bullying A Vampire: Taunting Aidan was probably not the best move, Connor.Especially since he had a rifle loaded with silver bullets. Corrupt the Cutie: They basically do this to Nora.

characters.name: Erin Shepard
characters.description: A runaway teenage werewolf. Josh finds out she's a werewolf after she comes to his hospital for a "dog scratch" during a full moon. Nora decides to take her in as her new legal guardian. Asshole Victim:Is killed by Liam after being hospitalized by Aidan. Dark and Troubled Past: Has been through 27 different foster homes in less than two years, according to her, the foster brother were molesting her. Sixth Ranger Traitor: She moves in with the main cast and is basically a new Roommate.Until she betrays their trust and tries to kill Aidan. You Have Outlived Your Usefulness: Liam murders her after she fails to kill Aidan before the others can learn that she'sThe Mole.

characters.name: LiamMcLean
characters.description: Brynn and Connor's father, who comes to Boston in the third season to try and find out what happened to to his son and daughter. Affably Evil: Usually maintains a polite demeanor and does try to befriend Josh and Nora before they make their loyalty to Aidan clear. He's still willing to kill a teenager to cover-up his manipulations. Anti-Villain: He wants to avenge the deaths of his children, and exterminate vampires; who are more often than not, vicious and remorseless serial killers. He is still a major antagonist. Big Bad: One of season 3's two Big Bads. Fantastic Racism: Against vampires. Justified, when one considers the majority of vampires are serial killers who haveFantastic Racismtowards werewolves.

characters.name: Ray
characters.description: The redneck werewolf that turned Josh. Back for the Dead:Gets his head smashed in by Josh in the season 3 premiere.He's killed again in the penultimate episode of Season 3.He's killedonce againin season 4, in an alternate timeline, this time by Aidan He's killed again in the penultimate episode of Season 3. He's killedonce againin season 4, in an alternate timeline, this time by Aidan Big Brother Mentor: Tries to guide Josh towards accepting being a werewolf and enjoying life with the condition.

characters.name: Nick Fenn
characters.description: An old crush of Sally's from college when he was her T.A. He died several years prior and he and Sally reunite for a brief romance. Came Back Wrong:Along with Sally in season 3 Fate Worse than Death: Combined withOur Ghosts Are Different, because he died in a drowning accident he relives the moment of his death, being strangled underwater and drowning all over, again, culminating in an explosion of ghostly water.He later ends up being "reaped" by Sally while she's under the influence of Scott, and is sent to Limbo where he is forced to keep drowning except for the times Sally manages to pull him out to try to escape.And then, after he escapesthat,he becomes a ravenous flesh-eating zombie who eats cats to keep from rotting, and very nearly eats his girlfriend Zoe as well. Being bashed in the head and becoming a ghost again is actually a relief for himDidn't think we were done yet, did you? Afterpassing through his door, his soul is destroyed and consumed by Donna.Poor guy can't catch a break. He later ends up being "reaped" by Sally while she's under the influence of Scott, and is sent to Limbo where he is forced to keep drowning except for the times Sally manages to pull him out to try to escape. And then, after he escapesthat,he becomes a ravenous flesh-eating zombie who eats cats to keep from rotting, and very nearly eats his girlfriend Zoe as well. Being bashed in the head and becoming a ghost again is actually a relief for him

characters.name: Stevie Adkins
characters.description: A friend of Sally's who committed suicide while they were still in high school over bullying. They reunite when Sally decides to go to her high school reunion as a ghost, mostly to confront the popular girl who died recently. Stevie introduces Sally to several other teenaged boy ghost friends of his, and indirectly teaches her about possessing and shredding. Butt-Monkey: Alive or as a ghost; Stevie just doesn't have any luck. Fate Worse than Death:After being shredded by Sally, Stevie's punishment in limbo is to watch his family live on happily without him as he watches on outside while hanging by a noose on a tree, despite the fact he overdosed to commit suicide. I Cannot Self-Terminate:Begs this of Sally, because he's too scared to commit suicide. Josh volunteers to put him down. I'm a Humanitarian:Despite Sally's warnings never to see his family again, Stevie gives into temptation and visits his mother and father who are happy to see him, but are cursed to die because of the spell. As his flesh craving hunger hits him during the decomposition, he decides to eat his parents' corpses. He admits this to Sally and Josh, and later admits that he also killed and ate the mailman.

characters.name: Suzanna Waite
characters.description: Aidan's wife from the 18th century. She was turned by Bishop, and returns to find Aidan in the present day. The Atoner: She has killed a grand total of one human in her 250 or so years of life.It was her son Isaac, after which she decided to kill any vampires she finds who prey on humans Drown The Witch: How she diedthe first time. Friendly Neighbourhood Vampire: Has killed exactly one human being in her 250+ years as a vampire. Even then, it was accidental. Hunter Of Her Own Kind: a vampire whose main mission in life is to kill other vampires who prey on and kill humans.

characters.name: The Reaper
characters.description: Enemy Within: See Split Personality and Jekyll and Hyde below. Grim Reaper: A ghost who claims to be one.He isn't. Jekyll & Hyde:The Reaper is actually a split personality of Sally's, and represents an imbalance in her psyche. Professional Killer: He claims that it's his job to maintain balance in the afterlife by destroying ghosts that have gone bad or refuse to move on. Split Personality:He is just a piece of Sally's fractured psyche

characters.name: Donna Gilchrist
characters.description: A strange woman that works at a local soup kitchen. She also happens to be a practitioner of the occult arts, and offers to bring Sally back for Josh and Nora... for a price. After her death at the hand of Sally, she becomes intrinsically linked to Sally's spirit, particularly their magical abilities. She later asks Sally to close up her only portal into the living plane, her death spot. Affably Evil: Is actually pretty friendly to Sally in the season 4 premiere. Of course, she admits that she's just biding her time as pleasantly as possible until Sally inevitably gives her what she wants.Proves to be just as affable when helping Sally later in the season, though by this time she isn't evil anymore. Proves to be just as affable when helping Sally later in the season, though by this time she isn't evil anymore. Back from the Dead: Donna reveals to Sally that she died once already, and her becoming a witch was a result of this. Big Bad: One of season three's two Big Bads, and arguably the most powerful adversary the protagonists have faced thus far.

characters.name: Ramona
characters.description: Thedemonicspirit of a little girl that has inhabited the roommates' Boston brownstone for forty yearsafter her parents sacrificed her as part of their cult to the demon lord Paimon. Her power has only grown with every death in the house, and she's not about to let the protagonists leave without a fight. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing:She pretends to be an innocent little girl but is actually a murderous demon Final Boss: The final villain the roommates have to deal with in the final season. Mind Rape:Twists the roommates' fears and insecurities from illusions of loved ones to convince them to kill themselves. Kill It with Fire:Aidan defeats her by burning the house down.
